units.source_text: 古歌：“秋来鸣鹿苦，响彻晚山阳。

en.t: An old poem says: In autumn the crying deer sound sorrowful, their voices echoing across the evening mountain slope.

units.source_text: 怜我独眠夜，泣声似此长。”

en.t: Pity me on nights when I sleep alone; their weeping calls go on as long as this.
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.
